ABOUT.paragraph-1: ESPAES - Is a Consultancy company of Specialized and Shared services, founded in 2022 and based in Luanda, Angola.
ABOUT.paragraph-2: Our way of working reflects the business ambition of working closely with our clients to support Organizations to grow, gain competitive advantage and bring positive changes in the market they operate in.
ABOUT.paragraph-3: The focus on innovation allows us to present disruptive solutions for the use of Corporate Customers and for the benefit of the end user.
ABOUT.paragraph-4: Espaes is a pioneer company in the Angolan market of shared services and specialized in Consulting.
ABOUT.mision-text: Act responsibly, through a methodical service, excellence and immediate response capacity, through a competent and differentiated team.
ABOUT.vision-text: Become the unavoidable reference in the national market, in the provision of specialized shared services that result in customer satisfaction at 360º..
ABOUT.values-text-1: Ethics: The underlying base of all our work and the differential in the day to day of our departments! The Soul of the Company.
ABOUT.values-text-2: Competence: Our ability to use the knowledge, skillset and past experiences of our team members for the benefit of our Customers.
ABOUT.values-text-3: Innovation: Our ability to learn and relearn in order to overcome and surpass expectations.
ABOUT.values-text-4: Business Attitude: Our mentality, which forces us to leave no stone unturned in the process of finding a solution, in order to help solve our clients problems, in the most professional way.
